import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name=0, header=None)

# Find header row with years
year_row_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Field and citizenship status', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
years = df.iloc[year_row_idx, 1:].astype(int).astype(str).tolist()

# Find row for Education
educ_row_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Education'].index[0]
values = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[educ_row_idx, 1:], errors='coerce')

max_year = years[values.reset_index(drop=True).idxmax()]
result = max_year

import pandas as pd

excel = pd.ExcelFile('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx')

header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.contains('Field and citizenship status', case=False, na=False)].index[0]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name=0, header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'field and citizenship status'].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip().replace('.0', '') for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
col_2023 = years.index('2023')

non_se_fields = ['Business', 'Education', 'Humanities and arts', 'Other non-science and engineering']
counts = {}
for field in non_se_fields:
    row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip() == field].index[0]
    counts[field] = int(df.iat[row, col_2023])

sorted_fields = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
result = [sorted_fields[0][0], sorted_fields[1][0]]

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nsf_sed_doctorates_by_field_and_citizenship.xlsx', sheet_name=0, header=None)
header_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'field and citizenship status'].index[0]
years = [str(val).strip().replace('.0', '') for val in df.iloc[header_row]]
col_1978 = years.index('1978')

psych_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'psychology'].index[0]
hum_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'humanities and arts'].index[0]

psych_val = int(df.iat[psych_row, col_1978])
hum_val = int(df.iat[hum_row, col_1978])

result = 'yes' if psych_val > hum_val else 'no'
